assign.now: reading the real classes, probing how replay behaves

log.msg: task opened. Plan: 1 probe how Item.open/Item.replay replay an act() line and a set line; 2 replay.test.mjs (characterization, passes today); 3 lab classes (LabWorld, LabTask, LabLayer, LabCounter, LabDoc); 4 the Replay page (four examples, two tapes, Reload, verdict, counters); 5 readme, parent link, css scope, shots at 400 and 1200 px; 6 report. The item tool (Servex) is not reachable in this sandbox, and append.mjs refuses a bare tasks line, so the plan is written here instead of as child tasks. node Server/usage-now.mjs fails here too (no window.before).

decision.question: Where does the Replay Lab live, and how does Reload rebuild?
options: core/Item/replay/ beside watch/, reload through the real Class.open with a memory Store
decision.why: watch/ is the sibling demo of the same class; Class.open is what a page load runs (root_from, attach, Store.read with replaying set). Item.replay (the node twin) builds a plain Item differently, which a failing test now records.

decision.question: Should the tape stamp saved lines with by and ts?
options: stamp like the item tool (default on, a box turns it off)
keep the raw delta lines only
decision.chose: stamp, with a box to turn it off
decision.why: The real writer stamps every line, and a replayed Task pins its clock to ts. Without the stamp the lab would repeat the first sketch's wrong claim that the timer restarts.

log.msg: finding: replaying act() lines runs the method again (spawns again); change lines never do. No public replaying flag: Store.replaying only on the Item.open path, Item.replay has none, Task._applying is private. Task keeps its clock in _ran_since/_ran_ms (plain fields): change lines leave a running task at 0:00; a replayed call keeps the time through the line's ts. Two tabs: act() cancels a toggle and keeps both +1; set agrees on a toggle and loses a +1. Drag: set lines are per field (up to 2 per move). Item.replay and Item.open disagree for a plain Item (failing test replay-vs-open.test.mjs, not fixed).

verified: node replay.test.mjs 42 checks pass; act.test.mjs 9 pass; delta-flow.test.mjs 10 pass; replay-vs-open.test.mjs fails on purpose. Page clicked through all four examples with Reload at 400 and 1200 px, light and dark, no horizontal scroll, no page errors; also served from a static server with no /api and no socket: it makes no /api/item request. Note: this Linux box cannot boot the app (ext/Chat/md.js imports /framework/ext/Markdown/md.js, the folder is ext/markdown); the shots rewrote that one path in the browser only. node Server/review.mjs was not run.
